metadata.question: Does the land surface temperature in Afghanistan increase in February 2018 compared to February 2017?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Collection: MODIS Land Surface Temperature (MOD11A2 or MYD11A2) - 8-day composite, or MOD11A1/MYD11A1 for daily - Date: February 2017 vs February 2018 - Location: Afghanistan country boundary 2. Masking strategy: - MODIS LST has QC bands to mask poor quality pixels - Should mask clouds and low quality data to get valid temperature readings 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero from Null/Error: - LST values are in Kelvin (typically 250-330K range) or need conversion - A valid result showing temperature decrease would be answer B - A valid result showing temperature increase would be answer A - If no valid pixels after masking -> C2 - If calculation returns None/NaN -> C3 - If no images found -> C1 ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const afghanistan = ee.FeatureCollection('USDOS/LSIB_SIMPLE/2017') .filter(ee.Filter.eq('country_na', 'Afghanistan')) .geometry(); const date2017_start = '2017-02-01'; const date2017_end = '2017-03-01'; const date2018_start = '2018-02-01'; const date2018_end = '2018-03-01'; // 2. Data Acquisition - MODIS Terra LST (8-day) const col2017 = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MOD11A2') .filterBounds(afghanistan) .filterDate(date2017_start, date2017_end) .select('LST_Day_1km'); const col2018 = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MOD11A2') .filterBounds(afghanistan) .filterDate(date2018_start, date2018_end) .select('LST_Day_1km'); const size2017 = await col2017.size().getInfo(); const size2018 = await col2018.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Feb 2017 images: ${size2017}`); console.log(`Feb 2018 images: ${size2018}`); if (size2017 === 0 || size2018 === 0) { console.log('No images found for one or both periods.'); console.log('C1'); return; } // 3. Processing - Create mean composites and apply scale factor // MODIS LST scale factor is 0.02, units are Kelvin const img2017 = col2017.mean().multiply(0.02); const img2018 = col2018.mean().multiply(0.02); // 4. Calculate mean temperature for each period const stats2017 = await img2017.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: afghanistan, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const stats2018 = await img2018.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: afghanistan, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const mean2017 = stats2017.LST_Day_1km_mean; const count2017 = stats2017.LST_Day_1km_count; const mean2018 = stats2018.LST_Day_1km_mean; const count2018 = stats2018.LST_Day_1km_count; console.log(`2017: Mean LST = ${mean2017 ? mean2017.toFixed(2) : 'null'} K, Pixels = ${count2017 || 0}`); console.log(`2018: Mean LST = ${mean2018 ? mean2018.toFixed(2) : 'null'} K, Pixels = ${count2018 || 0}`); // 5. Validation & Final Answer if (count2017 === 0 || count2018 === 0) { console.log('No valid pixels after processing.'); console.log('C2'); return; } if (mean2017 == null || mean2018 == null || isNaN(mean2017) || isNaN(mean2018)) { console.log('Calculation returned invalid values.'); console.log('C3'); return; } // Check if values are in reasonable range (Kelvin: 200-350K typical) if (mean2017 < 200 || mean2017 > 350 || mean2018 < 200 || mean2018 > 350) { console.log('Temperature values outside reasonable range.'); console.log('C3'); return; } const tempDiff = mean2018 - mean2017; console.log(`Temperature change: ${tempDiff.toFixed(2)} K`); if (tempDiff > 0) { console.log('Temperature increased in Feb 2018 vs Feb 2017.'); console.log('A'); } else { console.log('Temperature did not increase in Feb 2018 vs Feb 2017.'); console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
